criteria.reason: The patch correctly applies the Tier 1 bulk discount of 10% at the boundary quantity of 10 units.
The patch correctly calculates a subtotal of 500.00 with a 10% discount, yielding a 50.00 discount amount for 10 items at 50.0 each.
The bug in the boundary condition logic of the calculateTieredBulkDiscount function has been fixed by changing the condition from > to >=.
